root.label: South Australia legacy ICT systems audit

events.label: South Australia legacy ICT systems audit

slots.name: legacy hardware devices
slots.sentence: In a South Australian audit report of legacy ICT systems published in June, of the ten agencies reviewed, nearly half of the 11,602 hardware devices or appliances were determined to be legacy devices.

slots.name: case system age
slots.sentence: In one example, the Department for Child Protection’s case management system is now over 15 years old, and has limited vendor support.

slots.name: legacy technology funding
slots.sentence: The SA government has allocated $325.6m over the past three budgets in part to address legacy technology.

slots.name: legacy server share
slots.sentence: A Victoria government cybersecurity audit of its IT servers found 25% of the operating systems used by servers were no longer supported by the vendor, with 48% in extended support.

slots.name: extended support share
slots.sentence: A Victoria government cybersecurity audit of its IT servers found 25% of the operating systems used by servers were no longer supported by the vendor, with 48% in extended support.

slots.name: legacy systems proportion
slots.sentence: Almost one quarter of the operating systems and applications were also determined to be legacy.
